Summary: MQ-1: User Registration and OTP Login
Acceptance Criteria: Given a registered user, When they enter a valid OTP, Then they are logged in successfully. Given a user enters 3 wrong OTPs, When they try again, Then the account is locked for 10 minutes.
Given a patient on the search page, When they filter by specialty 'Cardiology' and available=true, Then only available cardiologists are shown.

Given a patient selects a free slot, When they confirm the booking, Then a unique booking ID is returned. Given a slot is already booked, When another patient tries to book it, Then a 409 Conflict is returned.

Given a patient has a booking, When they cancel more than 2 hours before the slot, Then the appointment is cancelled. Given a patient tries to cancel less than 2 hours before, When the request is made, Then it is rejected with 400.

Given a doctor completes a consultation, When they submit a prescription with diagnosis and medicines, Then the prescription is saved. Given medicines field is empty, When the form is submitted, Then a 400 error is returned.
Given an admin opens the dashboard, When today's date is selected, Then all appointments for today are shown with statuses Booked, Checked-in, or Completed.
